name: elicitkit
description: A curated catalog of rich question types for AI agents — portable spec, MCP reference implementation, community pack registry.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @elicitkit/spec build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/core build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/renderers build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/server build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/http build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/cli build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/conformance build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/pack-pr-review build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/playground build
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/core test && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/conformance test && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/server test && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/http test && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/cli test && pnpm --filter @elicitkit/pack-pr-review test
